• **Ustad Vilayat Khan** was a prominent **Sitar player.**
 
• He was born on 28 August 1928 in Gouripur in East Bengal, now Bangladesh.
 
• He invented a new technique of playing Sitar with the left hand which lasts for longer consistency.
 
• He also invented many Ragas enriching Indian Music.
 
• Mogubai Kurdikar (15 July 1904 – 10 February 2001) was a renowned Indian classical vocalist of the Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana
